batches.purpose: Clear fixes, low accuracy, stationary heading, stale/future/duplicate packets, signal gaps, multipath and impossible jumps
checks: correct road and direction where independently justified
withhold ambiguous claims
reject invalid packets without corrupting trusted state
recovery time and distance after signal returns
no confident wrong carriageway or bridge level

batches.purpose: One-way, turn restrictions, access classes, dated closures, conditional restrictions and exact endpoints
checks: every traversed edge and transition legal for the frozen profile/time
no destination relocation outside tolerance
documented no-route versus missing coverage
route geometry and maneuver alignment

batches.purpose: True wrong turns versus noisy drift, missed exits, repeated deviations, stale callbacks and context changes
checks: corroborated reroute trigger
detection delay separate from route calculation time
no illegal recovery or prohibited U-turn
no oscillation or stale result installation

batches.purpose: Forks, merges, grade separation, motorway exits, nested/complex roundabouts and close consecutive turns
checks: correct maneuver and exit count
correct approach and outgoing road
instruction indices and sequence align to geometry
lane assertions only with licensed verified lane data

batches.purpose: Nearby parallel roads, wrong carriageway, early proximity, overshoot, weak fixes and destination changes
checks: route progress plus proximity plus fresh corroboration
no false arrival
one arrival event per context
safe recovery after rejected evidence

batches.purpose: No network, partial coverage, corrupt/truncated maps, interrupted updates, stale packages and reconnects
checks: actual route calculation using verified local data
known-good snapshot survives failed update
missing data distinct from no legal route
no silent online fallback in offline mode
map version/freshness limits stated

batches.purpose: Warm/cold calculations, route lengths/scales, repeated reroutes and wall-clock soaks
checks: same workload/hardware/transport for ranked measurements
startup/map preparation separated from requests
raw latency samples and quantiles with sample counts
CPU/memory/storage growth and leaks
actual versus accelerated duration explicit
correctness retained throughout

batches.purpose: Location injection, coarse/precise permissions, background/stop/restart, screen-off, GPS loss and offline transitions
checks: actual integrated DMN component exercised, not just Android mock-location plumbing
route/GPS service lifecycle and notification stop
stale guidance suppressed
ephemeral debug/test APKs distinguished from release artifacts
no standalone replacement DMN app or production repository changes

scale_policy.initial: freeze small explicit cases and oracles; run baseline, diagnose, fix, retest all affected safety cases
scale_policy.expansion: seeded generated variants in bounded shards after harness/oracle verification
scale_policy.counting: separate unique base cases, generated variants, repeats, engine executions and independently verified real-world cases
scale_policy.truth: a million generated variants do not create a million independent road facts
scale_policy.limits: declare per-shard time/memory/request budgets and resume checkpoints before launching

independence from DMN, competitor consensus and source-map agreement

score_policy.formula: 10 * passed cases / frozen genuinely comparable judged cases; ties share rank
score_policy.incomplete: incomplete or unavailable execution is unranked, never zero-quality
score_policy.safety: critical safety failures block promotion independently of numeric score
score_policy.overall: no universal winner or cross-category composite without a separately frozen justified method

road_data_policy.future_comparison_batches: real licensed public road maps only; invented road networks remain internal/historical regression controls, not this requested validation
road_data_policy.only_simulated_input: GPS observations: noise, accuracy metadata, gaps, timestamps, headings and speeds
road_data_policy.identical_inputs: same frozen real-map snapshot/hash and byte-identical timestamped GPS observations per applicable cohort
road_data_policy.expected_truth: source-backed expected road behavior; geometry agreement alone is not legal or surveyed GNSS truth
road_data_policy.emulator: actual integrated engine required; private ephemeral test/debug APKs may be necessary for requested emulator tests; no production/release APK or new standalone DMN app
